loop.top3_series_pattern: trend_dominated, high predictability, weak seasonality, unstable model ranking across windows
loop.top3_why: The median combination on the stable pool (pool2) offers the most robust aggregation for a series with strong trend and unstable model rankings. Median is less sensitive to outliers and ranking shifts, matching the diagnosis that model ranking does not hold across windows. Its validation score is the best among the three candidates and the per‑window performance is consistently good, with no single window dominating the score.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A (mean) is also robust but its per‑window scores are slightly higher on the worst window, indicating more sensitivity to ranking changes. Candidate C (inverse‑error weighted) achieves a similar overall score but relies on error estimates that are highly variable given only three validation windows; this increases the risk of overfitting to the validation set and may not generalize well to the blind test window.
